answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Authorised property valuer warrant with property valuers standing changes that arithmetic: a warrant valuers confirm after valuation audits, so the mesa for each fake is paid in the real world. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the quartz of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The tundra is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
